meta.title: ForGuard — Autonomous Drone Guarding Conservation Forests
meta.description: ForGuard is a multi-parameter autonomous drone system integrated with a PV-PCM charging station, built to detect illegal activity in conservation forests sustainably.

hero.eyebrow: Autonomous Drone × Multi-Parameter Sensing × PV-PCM Charging
hero.title: Guarding conservation forests, tirelessly, around the clock.
hero.subtitle: ForGuard is an autonomous drone combining computer vision, acoustic detection, and a chemical sniffer to spot illegal activity early — backed by a self-sustaining solar PV-PCM charging station.

problem.title: Indonesia's conservation forests are losing their guardians
problem.description: Illegal logging, poaching, and wildlife trade keep eroding conservation areas — while ground patrols, watchtowers, and satellite imagery can no longer keep pace with vast, cloud-covered tropical terrain.

stats.label: Peak primary forest loss recorded in 2016

problem.source: Source: Global Forest Watch, Auriga Nusantara, Ministry of Environment and Forestry, Goodstats.id — cited in the ForGuard research paper

solution.title: Three technology pillars of ForGuard
solution.description: ForGuard fuses electronic eyes, ears, and a nose into a single autonomous drone that never runs out of power.

pillars.title: Autonomous Drone
pillars.description: Flies, maps, and lands on its own with intelligent path planning — minimizing operator intervention across hard-to-reach forest terrain.

pillars.title: Multi-Parameter Detection
pillars.description: Cross-verified visual (YOLOv8), acoustic (MFCC + ML), and chemical (CO sniffer) signals reduce false alarms and raise detection reliability.

pillars.title: PV-PCM Charging Station
pillars.description: An automatic solar charging station using Phase Change Material — the drone flies continuously with no cables and no operator.

howItWorks.title: From patrol to follow-up, in one continuous loop
howItWorks.description: Following ForGuard's full operating mechanism (Appendix 3 of the paper): the drone patrols, detects, reports, then returns to charge itself.

steps.title: Patrol the Forest Area
steps.description: The autonomous drone follows a scheduled route over the conservation area using 3D Jump Point Search path planning.

steps.title: Multi-Parameter Detection
steps.description: ICR camera + YOLOv8, an MFCC-based microphone, and a CO chemical sniffer scan simultaneously for signs of illegal activity.

steps.title: Analysis & Verification
steps.description: Signals across all three parameters are cross-checked to suppress false positives before an alert is sent.

steps.title: Alert Sent to Rangers
steps.description: Data streams in real time via LoRa to the monitoring app — rangers can verify camera and audio evidence and act on it.

steps.title: Autonomous Landing & Charging
steps.description: When battery is low, the drone lands itself on the PV-PCM charging pad and recharges before resuming patrol.

detection.title: Three electronic senses, one reliable decision
detection.description: Each parameter reinforces the others — reducing reliance on any single sensor type in a dynamic forest environment.

tabs.name: Visual
tabs.title: Computer Vision — YOLOv8
tabs.description: An Infrared Cut Filter Removable (ICR) camera enables 24-hour monitoring. YOLOv8 detects humans and weapons in real time, while 1D Synthetic Aperture imaging cuts processing complexity by up to 1/10th compared to 2D methods.

tabs.name: Audio
tabs.title: Acoustic Early Warning — MFCC
tabs.description: An onboard microphone captures the impulsive signature of gunshots and chainsaw noise. Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) extraction separates genuine gunshots from other impulsive sounds like firecrackers.

tabs.name: Chemical
tabs.title: Chemical Sniffer — CO Residue
tabs.description: A three-electrode electrochemical CO sensor detects gunpowder combustion residue in the air, reinforcing the validity of suspected illegal activity when combined with visual and acoustic detection.

charging.title: An autonomous PV-PCM powered charging station
charging.description: Battery limits are no longer a bottleneck. ForGuard lands itself, recharges itself, and resumes patrol — powered by solar panels with Phase Change Material technology that keeps panel temperature stable in tropical climates.

features.title: Autonomous Landing
features.description: A modular 60×60 cm, orientation-independent charging pad — the drone doesn't need to land with precision.

features.title: Smart Relay Correction
features.description: The microcontroller automatically flips power line polarity if initial charging fails, guaranteeing up to 100% reliability.

features.title: MPPT Perturb & Observe
features.description: An MPPT algorithm stabilizes solar panel output toward a consistent 12V / 3A reference voltage.

gallery.title: ForGuard 3D Design
gallery.description: Concept renders of the drone and charging station, engineered for long-term autonomous operation in tropical forest environments.

appPreview.title: One app, full operational control
appPreview.description: Rangers and operators monitor drone status, multi-parameter detection results, and charging station health in real time — complete with detection history and remote emergency controls.

roadmap.title: From lab research to a nationwide monitoring network
roadmap.description: ForGuard's development follows four stages, from lab-scale technical validation to integration with the Ministry of Environment and Forestry's Sipongi command center.

stages.title: Research & Prototyping
stages.description: AI algorithm development, sniffer sensor integration, and lab testing of PV-PCM efficiency. Target: TRL 4.

stages.title: Limited Field Trial
stages.description: Deployment in an educational forest / campus area with forest-like topography (1–2 hectares) to validate weather resilience.

stages.title: Pilot Project
stages.description: Partnership with a National Park authority for patrol coverage of one high-risk forest resort sector.

stages.title: Scaling & Integration
stages.description: Mass production of charging stations and data integration with the Ministry's Sipongi command center across priority national parks.

team.title: Team Burpunice
team.description: Developed by engineering students at Universitas Diponegoro, Semarang, Indonesia.
